title: A finite Tor amplitude bounds the external product below
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and f:X→S, g:Y→S scheme morphisms. If K is bounded below in the etale A-module derived category of X and L is an arbitrary etale A-module complex on Y having finite Tor amplitude [def-kun-tor-amplitude], then their external product p_X^*K tensor^L_A p_Y^*L [def-kun-derived-tensor] is bounded below in the product etale derived category. In particular, for lower bound c of K and Tor interval [a,b] of L, a+c is a lower bound.

source.place: Paragraph 1, lower bound for the external product; proved from the existing general Tor-amplitude tensor estimate

proof.text: Choose a lower bound c of K and an interval [a,b] for L. Exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] preserves the lower bound, and its identification with derived pullback gives the same bound for the first pulled-back factor. The proved general API torAmplitudeIn_leftDerivedUpperStar preserves the Tor interval of the second factor.

Use the proved general derived-category theorem isGE_tensor_of_torAmplitudeIn for the pulled-back finite-Tor factor tensored with the first factor in degrees at least c. Its bound is a+c. The derived braiding transports this bound to the tensor in the order defining the external product. These APIs are in WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/Derived/Stability/Basic.lean and WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/DerivedCategory/FlatModel.lean.
